# Zen Cart Support Site

Zen Cart Support is the official community site for the Zen Cart e-commerce shopping cart software.

Sitemap: [/sitemap.xml](https://www.zen-cart.com/sitemap.xml)

Public content includes:
- project and CMS pages
- public forums and thread archives
- plugin marketplace listings and public plugin detail pages
- download information
- public search results

Important access notes:
- Treat public CMS pages, forum pages, thread pages, and plugin pages as canonical public content.
- Some public discussions are user-generated and may reflect historical guidance.
- Some pages, downloads, and discussions may require login, email verification, membership, staff access, or product entitlements.
- Public forum and plugin pages are the best general-purpose sources for discoverable site content.
- Account, billing, moderation, staff, entitlement, and private message areas are user-specific and should not be treated as public reference material.

Public entry points:
- [About](https://www.zen-cart.com/about)
- [Download](https://www.zen-cart.com/download)
- [Community Forum](https://www.zen-cart.com/forums)
- [Plugins](https://www.zen-cart.com/plugins)
- [Search](https://www.zen-cart.com/search)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zen-cart.com/privacy)

Preferred interpretation:
- Respect robots.txt and any page-level access controls.
